integrity: Analytical proof with exact rational witness and supplementary self-contained rational-arithmetic checker. No independent scientific validation or expert audit.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns annealed mean-vector growth for independent annual choices of two cyclic-phase Leslie products. It does not imply almost-sure growth, finite-population persistence, or applicability to larger age structures. Historical priority is provisional, and general matrix-pencil results could dominate the special case.
title: Sharp annealed phase mixing for two-age seasonal populations
